workload.model_checkpoint: 70B Dense / 140 GB BF16 (or 140 GB FP8 MoE Shard) loaded across an 8xH100 Node from Local NVMe RAID0 / Lustre / S3
workload.binary_header_contracts: Safetensors: [8-byte LE uint64 Header Size N] + [N-byte UTF-8 JSON Header] + [64B-aligned Raw Tensor Buffers]; GGUF: ['GGUF' Magic + Version + Tensor/KV Counts + Embedded Tokenizer + Super-Block Quantized Buffers]
workload.autoscaling_impact: Every second of weight loading during K8s pod scale-up burns 8 GPUs ($20/hr/node) at 0% inference throughput

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统 PyTorch Pickle (.bin / .pt) (存在 RCE 远程代码执行漏洞 + 2倍主存拷贝 = 168.0s)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Legacy PyTorch Pickle (.bin / .pt) (Arbitrary Code Execution RCE Risk + 2x Host RAM Copy = 168.0s)
tiers.recommended_for: Deprecated for production model distribution; Python pickle VM executes arbitrary __reduce__ payloads and doubles CPU RAM.

tiers.name: Tier 2: GGUF 单文件自包含格式 (内嵌 Tokenizer + K-Quant 超块量化 · 端侧 AIPC / KTransformers 标配)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: GGUF Single-File Self-Contained Format (Embedded Tokenizer + K-Quant Super-Blocks for Edge/Hybrid)
tiers.recommended_for: Apple Silicon, AIPC (llama.cpp / Ollama), and KTransformers CPU+GPU hybrid serving needing single-file Q4_K_M / Q8_0 deployment.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 标准 Safetensors + OS mmap 零拷贝映射 (本地 NVMe 14.5s，但网盘 4KB 缺页中断会降速)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Standard HuggingFace Safetensors + OS mmap Zero-Copy (14.5s on Local NVMe; Stalls on Network 4KB Page Faults)
tiers.recommended_for: Default open-weight distribution & single-node vLLM/SGLang serving backed by local PCIe Gen5 NVMe SSDs.

tiers.name: Tier 4: Pre-Sharded Safetensors / Tensorizer + Run:ai Streamer / GDS (O_DIRECT 并发流 + GPUDirect 直写 HBM = 3.2s)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Pre-Sharded Safetensors / Tensorizer + Run:ai Streamer / GDS (O_DIRECT + GPUDirect Storage cuFile = 3.2s)
tiers.recommended_for: Serverless GPU autoscaling & multi-node K8s clusters: bypasses OS page cache via cuFile/O_DIRECT for 52.5x faster cold start.
